body: - 2026-10-27: `rerere.enabled` is on for this checkout, so a cherry-pick's conflict resolutions land in the shared `.git/rr-cache` and replay on later picks — run every trial or take cherry-pick of an upstream sync as `git -c rerere.enabled=false cherry-pick …`. Extended 2026-11-19: `git apply --3way` during a merge records rerere preimages too — run it under the same `-c rerere.enabled=false`, and clear what it left with `git rerere clear`.

- 2026-11-19: A blitz-tests target installs no tracing subscriber and blitz-dom's `tracing` feature is off in it, so `RUST_LOG=trace` prints nothing from the engine there — locate an engine-side failure with temporary prints, restoring each instrumented file by its saved bytes and comparing sha256 before the green reading.

- 2026-11-19: A check written over a path just measured pins the measured value, never the value the path should give — a check asserting the expected behaviour reads red against the measurement; record the surprise beside the check and pin the literal.

The session merged upstream main 547d7514b into the branch with two parents: Stylo 0.24, parley 0.13, winit beta.4 and Dioxus held at 0.7.3. CI, the a11y leg and the stand-repeat leg passed.
It replaced the dispatch callback in every engine event path with upstream's event queue. Programmatic focus changes now fire blur, focusout, focus and focusin, and script-dispatched events read isTrusted false.
It moved where the accessibility tree is refreshed. The shell's redraw now pushes the tree after style resolve whenever the engine's changed set is non-empty, then clears that set. Poll no longer refreshes the tree.
It took the founder's widenings W1 to W9: an opt-in devtools CDP listener with no default feature turning it on; visibility collapse hidden from the accessibility tree; a cancelled pointerup that still clicks; a measured SVG mask attribute fetch.
It fixed an upstream inline-box placeholder defect in the engine. A private fallback font family is now registered in every font context and holds the bullet font.
It retired the old focus-event generator and the runtime change synthesis (which stays retired), and it removed the parley code editor crate.

body: Accessibility tree refreshed on change: the refresh moved from the shell's poll to its redraw, after style resolve, whenever the changed set is non-empty. The redraw then clears the changed set.

What the engine's changed set marks and Harness settle leaves the changed set: a new clear-changes call empties the set, and the shell's redraw now clears it after each tree push. The take of changed nodes is unchanged.
Accessibility tree through the document trait and Accessibility tree built through the document's own method: the shell now builds the tree from the wrapping document after resolve.

Tab and Shift+Tab move focus with focus events and Removing the focused node drops focus with blur steps: setting and clearing focus now queue blur, focusout, focus and focusin through the engine's event queue (W5). Upstream's focus-event generator is gone.
Focus fixup reads inertness alone and Inert subtree excluded: the inert fix-up now clears focus through a silent clear that queues no blur or focusout. The rule stands, through a new path.
Driver type focuses a select with no click: the driver now focuses the select through a new silent focus call that queues no focus event.

Keyboard activation (Enter, Space, handler order), Select key change fires one input then one change, and the single-choice select input and change events: the select choice, key-up and generated input paths now queue user-agent events instead of calling a dispatch callback. Event order is in the rows' reach.

Range input keys, Range input pointerdown sets value, Range input click gives focus not value, and the range input contract items (input event, pointerdown, click): the range move path now queues its events through the event queue.

Checkbox or radio click toggles, fires input, focuses; One engine change per checkable click; A click focuses a button; A disabled form control stops the click walk: pointerdown, pointerup and click now follow upstream's split with default-prevented handling. A pointerup cancelled by a handler still clicks (W7).
Driver click in a shown scrollbar band drags: a cancelled pointerup still ends a scrollbar drag (upstream's, W7).

Double click threshold and Double click read on the document's clock: a cancelled pointerdown now still counts towards a double click without selecting text (upstream's). Smooth scroll progress reads the document's clock.

Hidden content kept out of the tree, Hidden content excluded from the accessibility tree, and the accessibility tree hidden content contract (visibility hidden, display none, hidden, aria-hidden): an element with visibility collapse is now kept out of the tree too (W9).
AccessKit requests reach one event handler and Synthetic click is a primary click at the centre: the engine paths these requests and clicks enter now queue events instead of dispatching them inline.
accesskit_xplat as the platform adapter: the adapter crate gains an iOS platform implementation (upstream's).

Accessibility as a default-on feature, Browser accessibility feature off by default, and Dioxus accessibility feature taken only by name: both default feature sets changed. The browser app's default is now skia, cookies, cache, screenshot, apple-font-embolden, scrollbars and mimalloc, with no devtools. Dioxus native's default no longer has clipboard.
WCAG contrast ratio matching Chrome and Lint contrast shares the harness reader: the harness contrast reader was edited in the merge, which reached its imports and its colour reads.
Open select list colours are engine constants and Open select list rows take one height: the open select list's paint and its overlay list state were reached by the merge.

Password caret placed by bullets and Password value masked: the bullet font is now also registered under a private placeholder family in every font context, including a context the document was given.
:focus-visible never matches, :focus does, and :open matches an open details or dialog: selector matching moved into upstream's split Stylo module on Stylo 0.24 (selectors 0.43).
Scheme change counts as a device change and Hidpi or zoom change reshapes text: device change detection moved into upstream's Stylo device module.

The a11y CI leg, Accessibility test leg in the slow tier, Accessibility checks gate CI, and Stand checks repeated three rounds: the a11y leg and stand-repeat (3 of 3 rounds) were green on the merge. The CI workflow gains the Android NDK steps.
Dioxus render into a mutation buffer and the Dioxus document reached-handler record: the Dioxus document now flushes the engine's pending DOM events. Dioxus is held at 0.7.3.
Text runs label their parent element: text paint and inline layout were rebuilt on parley 0.13. An inline-box placeholder now shapes with a fallback family when no font can shape it.

The session merged upstream main (547d7514b) into the 0.4.0 branch as a two-parent merge, CI green 17 of 17 on the first attempt, every left-out upstream commit named with its reason.
It took upstream's event-queue model: every escher event path (pointer down and up, click, key up, select choice, row gesture, range move, generated text input) queues its events instead of taking a dispatch callback, and programmatic focus now fires blur, focusout, focus and focusin; the inert fix-up and the driver's select focus stay silent through two new silent focus calls.
The accessibility tree is no longer refreshed on poll: the shell window pushes it after resolve on redraw when the document's changed set is non-empty, then clears the set.
It fixed an upstream defect where an inline-block inside text no loaded font can shape was never placed: a private placeholder font family is registered in every font context, a given one included; proven to move no reading where a font exists.
It bumped Stylo 0.22 to 0.24, parley 0.12 to 0.13, skrifa 0.44 to 0.49, winit beta.3 to beta.4, svgtypes to 0.16.2, held Dioxus 0.7.3, moved the network layer onto rustls, and made Skia the default renderer of the browser app and the wpt runner.
It added upstream's devtools inspector crate (a CDP server on 127.0.0.1, opt-in by the devtools feature, no default build turns it on) and retired the parley code editor crate and the agents guide; script-dispatched events now read isTrusted false, a cancelled pointerup still clicks, and visibility collapse hides a node from the accessibility tree.

The session merged upstream/main at 547d7514b into the 0.4.0 build branch as a two-parent merge, CI green 17/17 on the first attempt, with each upstream commit left out named with its reason.
The merge brought an opt-in DevTools protocol server crate (devtools feature, off in every default feature set): a TcpListener on 127.0.0.1 at BLITZ_CDP_PORT, no Origin check and no authentication, and an env read BLITZ_DEVTOOLS_FRONTEND_DIR; its log lines take an engine target, redacted by escher's sink.
The event-queue model replaced the dispatch callback in every escher event path: programmatic focus now queues blur, focusout, focus and focusin, while the inert fix-up and the driver's select focus stay silent; script-dispatched events read isTrusted false; a cancelled pointerup still clicks; the runtime change synthesis stays retired.
Engine pins moved (Stylo 0.24, selectors 0.43, parley 0.13, skrifa 0.49, winit beta.4, svgtypes 0.16.2; Dioxus held at 0.7.3), blitz-net moved to rustls, four precise lock updates cleared eight audit advisories, Skia became a default renderer of the browser and the WPT runner, and the parley_code_editor crate and AGENTS.md were retired.
The accessibility tree is now pushed after resolve when the changed set is non-empty, an inline-box placeholder got an engine font fallback, and a mask attribute URL was measured to fetch only through the stamped request constructor.

body: The rule that engine and upstream crates compile tracing only behind the tracing cargo feature, and the telemetry-strategy overview stating it: a new upstream workspace crate, the DevTools protocol server, joins those crates and logs.

The sink target allowlist and the capture that counts framework targets at warn and above: the DevTools protocol server brings a new log target; the capture checks read green inside fast and stand-repeat.

The rules that engine log sites write fixed messages, that engine targets print safe fields only, and the reach of the scrubbing sink: the new crate's log lines take an engine target, their messages redacted by escher's sink.

Rows stating a surface reads no env var, or naming RUST_LOG as the sink's configuration read: two new env reads arrive, BLITZ_CDP_PORT and BLITZ_DEVTOOLS_FRONTEND_DIR, under the devtools feature only.

Mutation buffer contents stay in memory: the mutator now hands mutation records (node inserted, removed, attribute and character data changed) to a devtools provider when one is configured under the devtools feature.

The metric-coverage overview naming the in-app overlay, blitz-paint's counters and the WPT runner's figures: the paint debug overlay was edited and the WPT runner gained a renderer choice (cpu, tiny-skia, skia) and a manifest loader.
WPT scores and results published from upstream only: the WPT workflow and its diff-to-PR script took upstream's edits (results skipped on a revision mismatch).
The WPT report message and subtest message contracts: the reftest and crash-test runners were edited by the merge.

CI on GitHub workflows and the fork CI artifacts (the per-leg log on failure, the coverage report on success, two artifacts): the CI workflow was edited, the Android job gaining SHA-pinned NDK steps; the run read 17 of 17 checks.

The page script event contracts for change on a checkbox, change on a radio and the change count: every escher event path now queues through the user-agent event queue in place of the dispatch callback; the runtime change synthesis stays retired.

Script error source labels for event listeners and event microtasks: the script runtime's event dispatch was edited, script-dispatched events now reading isTrusted false and programmatic focus now firing blur, focusout, focus and focusin.
The driver emits no event and installs no subscriber, and one span per driver command: the driver's command execution was edited so its select focus calls the silent focus; no span field changed.
Select chosen set and select list row label never logged, and the open list shot: select choice and row gestures now queue their events through the event queue.

No file loads from non-file documents and a failed stylesheet leaves the pending critical set: the engine fetch path was edited (an import with an unparsable URL is refused) and a mask attribute URL now fetches through the same stamped request, a fragment-only one as a data URL.

Snapshot rows that read the accessibility tree (clickable nodes and text, open list row bounds): the tree is now pushed after resolve when the changed set is non-empty, and an element with visibility collapse is hidden from it.
The state registry and page-without-registered-state rows: the Dioxus native document and its signal registry test sources were re-applied over the merge, with Dioxus held at 0.7.3.
